name: branding-navy-helvetica-typography-and-colour-share-sheet
title: Helvetica Neue and Colour Share Sheet
whatItIs: A tall pale sheet with a mixed sans and italic serif title, a cartoon pencil mascot peeking above a giant navy 'Helvetica Neue', a weight slider (Light to Bold), and a circular palette ring with hex chips and usage percentages around a script monogram.
whatItMeans: Percentages on the colour ring show how much of each colour to use, and the pencil adds humour to an otherwise serious system.
techniques: Colour ring segments sized by usage percentage
Cartoon mascot leaning on the specimen
Weight slider with tick marks and a cursor
Sans and italic serif contrast in the title
Floating hex chips around the ring

vocabulary.definition: The percentage share each colour should occupy.
A control-like graphic showing weights from light to bold.
A character placed within technical documentation for personality.
